extracted.intended_audience: event organizers and planners (in-person, virtual, and hybrid)
extracted.subtask_description: A broad listicle of 66 event formats and ideas with short descriptions and professional tips for organizing memorable community, fundraising, corporate, and virtual events. Designed to help event creators choose and execute suitable event formats.

rubrics_metrics.name: Standup or comedy show
rubrics_metrics.description: A standup or comedy show provides a fun, entertaining evening and allows attendees to bond as they share in the same experience.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do it like a pro: Hire local comedians or performers who specialize in your event’s topic. Allow everyone access to the audio source, and include an open mic session and improv games.

rubrics_metrics.name: Book reading
rubrics_metrics.description: Choose an author or particular book and host a virtual or in-person read-along to spark conversation and foster deeper connections between community members.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do it like a pro: Make sure attendees bring their own book copies for the read-along and choose topics relevant to community issues.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cabaret
rubrics_metrics.description: A stage performance mixing music, song, dance, and drama with an overarching theme; adaptable to restaurants, bars, nightclubs, or online formats.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do it like a pro: Make it an inclusive event by collaborating with a wide range of performers from all kinds of backgrounds. Reach out to local musicians to bring a fresh, local twist.

rubrics_metrics.name: Masquerade
rubrics_metrics.description: A themed dress-up party (commonly around Halloween) where guests explore new identities and wear elaborate costumes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do it like a pro: Lead a workshop before the masquerade where people can learn how to make their own costumes to increase investment and ensure plenty of outfits; this can be done online.

rubrics_metrics.name: Dance, ball, or disco
rubrics_metrics.description: Lively dance events (ballroom, clubbing, competitive or fun) that bring communities together and reduce stress.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do it like a pro: Bring in local musicians, DJs, or dance instructors to make the dance unique and accessible for everyone.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fandom gathering
rubrics_metrics.description: Events for fans of particular pop-culture subcultures (sci‑fi, anime, gaming) to connect and celebrate their passions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do it like a pro: Include a panel discussion and invite VIPs (celebrities or authors). Make sure you get the word out—use marketing tools like Eventbrite Boost to find hard-to-reach fans.

rubrics_metrics.name: Festival
rubrics_metrics.description: Multi-day, often music-focused events (or film/play festivals) hosted at a venue to introduce new artists and foster relationships.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do it like a pro: Clarify the purpose and theme, determine the target audience and experience, and set a budget.

rubrics_metrics.name: Networking evening
rubrics_metrics.description: Professional gatherings designed to bring like-minded people together to chat, share experiences, and find common ground.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do it like a pro: Select a venue that aligns with the desired atmosphere—choose spaces that encourage conversation and interaction, such as cozy lounges, rooftop terraces, or unique locations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Participatory events
rubrics_metrics.description: Events where attendees shape and change the experience and outcomes as they unfold, making events unpredictable and engaging.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do it like a pro: Use technology (online polls) for virtual events, plan interactive activities, and ensure attendees have structured ways to interact and discuss.

rubrics_metrics.name: Party
rubrics_metrics.description: Social gatherings that break down barriers and provide fun, informal opportunities for attendees to connect.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do it like a pro: Pay attention to details—decorations, lighting, ambiance, and aesthetics—and include ice-breaker activities to make the party memorable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prom
rubrics_metrics.description: A themed nostalgic event modeled on high school prom, offering attendees a chance to relive a fantasy experience.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do it like a pro: Choose a unifying theme and publicize the event well in advance via an event page so attendees can prepare their outfits.

rubrics_metrics.name: Rally
rubrics_metrics.description: Gatherings (in-person or online) centered on political or social causes to show solidarity and take action.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do it like a pro: Check and secure required permits, coordinate with local authorities, choose a suitable location, and plan crowd management and safety measures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Rave
rubrics_metrics.description: Large dance parties, often featuring electronic music and neon aesthetics, focused on high-energy experiences.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do it like a pro: Ensure a safe, secure location; make attendees aware of rules (e.g., no drugs); bring a quality sound system and curate a great playlist.

rubrics_metrics.name: Religious events
rubrics_metrics.description: Events organized around religious observance, celebration, or fundraising that bring believers together.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do it like a pro: Consider hosting fundraisers to aid the less fortunate, and research local laws and regulations to ensure smooth operations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Silent disco
rubrics_metrics.description: Dancing where attendees wear headphones so music is individually streamed; adaptable to virtual rooms and genre-based channels.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do it like a pro: Decide on a theme for the music, encourage themed dress, and consider trying a silent disco beforehand to learn best practices.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ribbon cutting
rubrics_metrics.description: Ceremonial opening of new public spaces with officials present; a community celebration and PR opportunity.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do it like a pro: Arrange meetings with officials early, choose a date/time that works for stakeholders, and contact media outlets ahead of time with project details to gain coverage.

rubrics_metrics.name: Talent or variety show
rubrics_metrics.description: Competitions where entrants showcase unique talents before an audience and judging panel, often with prizes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do it like a pro: Plan an award ceremony, offer special prizes, and create a grand finale to elevate the event.

rubrics_metrics.name: Auction
rubrics_metrics.description: Items or services are sold to the highest bidder in-person or online; a proven fundraising format.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do it like a pro: Solicit high-value donations from local businesses (artwork, vacations) and offer visibility in exchange; consider an online auction platform and detailed lot information.

rubrics_metrics.name: Gig
rubrics_metrics.description: Smaller, intimate musical performances that let audiences get closer to performers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do it like a pro: Put together a local band (friends/coworkers) or invite a celebrity to boost excitement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fashion show
rubrics_metrics.description: Runway-style events (scaled down from major fashion weeks) useful for fundraising and promoting local designers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do it like a pro: Consider partnering with a professional production company for large-scale shows to meet budget and quality expectations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Improv show
rubrics_metrics.description: Improvisational comedy where performers create sketches from audience prompts; interactive and spontaneous.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do it like a pro: Make it original by creating teams and turning it into a competition judged by audience laughter; manage venue capacity and ticketing accordingly.

rubrics_metrics.name: Performance art
rubrics_metrics.description: Original, often unpredictable works combining theater, film, music, spoken word, and other disciplines.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do it like a pro: Plan collaboratively with artists, ensure technical needs are met, and have staff on-site to maintain order and handle issues.

rubrics_metrics.name: Race
rubrics_metrics.description: Competitive endurance events (running, cycling, swimming) commonly used to raise funds and awareness.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do it like a pro: Tie distance goals to donations (e.g., donation per miles), and use platforms like Eventbrite to collect donations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Film screening
rubrics_metrics.description: Screenings ranging from casual movie nights to exclusive documentary showings; flexible venues and themes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do it like a pro: Charge admission or sell themed refreshments to raise funds; partner with local organizations to manage logistics.

rubrics_metrics.name: The performing arts (ballet, musicals, opera, theater)
rubrics_metrics.description: Stage-centered arts events appreciated by attentive audiences, often requiring specialized production standards.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do it like a pro: Hire experts in the respective fields to ensure the event meets industry standards and audience expectations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Silent auction
rubrics_metrics.description: Closed-bid auctions where bids are secret until boxes are opened; common charity fundraiser.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do it like a pro: Consider contracting a professional auctioneer to manage the process and ensure secure bid collection.

rubrics_metrics.name: Awards ceremony
rubrics_metrics.description: Events recognizing and rewarding teams or individuals (e.g., Oscars-style) that motivate and encourage excellence.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do it like a pro: Assemble a panel of judges to review nominees, select winners, and plan award presentations; budget for prizes and entertainment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Conference
rubrics_metrics.description: Multi-session gatherings mixing keynotes, panels, breakouts, and roundtables for knowledge sharing and networking.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do it like a pro: Use social media to promote the event, create interactive experiences (polls, quizzes, scavenger hunts), and have a follow-up strategy to stay connected with attendees.

rubrics_metrics.name: ConfEx (conference + exhibition)
rubrics_metrics.description: Events combining talks/presentations with exhibition booths and networking opportunities for greater content diversity.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do it like a pro: Prepare to manage both presentations and exhibitors, plan logistics carefully, and use platforms like Eventbrite for registration and scheduling.

rubrics_metrics.name: Convention
rubrics_metrics.description: Large gatherings (in-person or virtual) that bring an industry or fandom together to discuss best practices or celebrate shared interests.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do it like a pro: Plan carefully with vendors and volunteers; if online, focus on maximizing attendance and engagement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Congress
rubrics_metrics.description: Formal meetings (often political) or professional gatherings used to share ideas and network internationally.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do it like a pro: Brief participants on objectives and expected outcomes and create a pre-defined schedule of activities and speakers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Consumer show or fair
rubrics_metrics.description: Vendor-filled events targeted at consumers around a theme, suitable for many industries and adaptable online.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do it like a pro: Plan vendor layout with ample space and provide clear directional signage to help visitor flow.

rubrics_metrics.name: Exhibition or trade show
rubrics_metrics.description: Typically B2B, professional events focused on showcasing products and services; often held online as well.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do it like a pro: Create an organized agenda with engaging presentations and provide amenities (refreshments, charging stations) for attendee comfort.

rubrics_metrics.name: Flash events
rubrics_metrics.description: Events promoted with little lead time to trigger impulse attendance; useful if you have a large following.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do it like a pro: Leverage your network to spread the word and invest time in planning, preparation and promotion; use checklists to stay organized.

rubrics_metrics.name: Interview or fireside chat
rubrics_metrics.description: Conversational formats to extract expert knowledge without a prepared presentation, more casual in tone.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do it like a pro: Prioritize and practice questions in advance and remember to ask follow-up questions to keep the conversation engaging.

rubrics_metrics.name: Product launch
rubrics_metrics.description: Party-style events to showcase a company’s latest release, focusing on creating a polished, positive first impression.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do it like a pro: Establish measurable goals for the launch to focus planning on outcomes that matter.

rubrics_metrics.name: Q&A session
rubrics_metrics.description: Audience questions-and-answers after talks or as stand-alone sessions to build trust and clarify topics.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do it like a pro: Research common questions in advance (e.g., Reddit/Quora), prepare thought-provoking starter questions, and plan moderation to keep things on track.

rubrics_metrics.name: Presentation
rubrics_metrics.description: Aimed to inform, persuade, or build goodwill; should be more than just slides and can be a standalone event.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do it like a pro: Include varied audiovisual cues and audience participation methods (polls, questions) to increase engagement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Forum
rubrics_metrics.description: Structured gatherings for debate and airing opinions, useful for legal, political, or industry discussions; easy to do online.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do it like a pro: Use a moderator to keep conversation on track, provide ample Q&A time, and record insights gleaned during discussions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Seminar
rubrics_metrics.description: Focused events with structured academic exercises designed to help attendees learn and retain knowledge.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do it like a pro: Plan specific outcomes for attendees, tailor activities to the allotted time, and leave room for unexpected but valuable topics/questions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Signing engagement
rubrics_metrics.description: Author signings (or similar) allowing fans to get items signed and meet creators, often part of fandom events.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do it like a pro: Ensure authors have plenty of items to sign, provide markers, and organize orderly lines or seating to manage crowds.

rubrics_metrics.name: Breakfast briefing
rubrics_metrics.description: Morning format for announcements or launches targeting business audiences who prefer early events.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do it like a pro: Tailor breakfast options to audience preferences and offer variety (continental, vegan, gluten-free).

rubrics_metrics.name: Panel session
rubrics_metrics.description: Multiple experts discuss a topic with a moderator guiding the discussion to provide varied perspectives.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do it like a pro: Prioritize questions, ensure equal speaking time for panelists, and have the moderator steer conversation and close tangents.

rubrics_metrics.name: Endurance race
rubrics_metrics.description: Long-duration events testing individual endurance (running, cycling, swimming, or novel formats like 24-hour dance).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do it like a pro: Plan carefully for participant safety and support (medical checks, aid stations) and consider secure transport for belongings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Food and drink event
rubrics_metrics.description: Events featuring stalls, vendors, or interactive cooking experiences that educate, entertain, and support local businesses.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do it like a pro: Incorporate sustainably sourced local food, and consider chef talks about the food’s origins for added value.

rubrics_metrics.name: Gaming event
rubrics_metrics.description: Events for social gamers or competitive gamers (eSports), including opportunities for education about game design and industry topics.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do it like a pro: Use technology (VR/AR, mobile gaming) and bring in experts to discuss game design, eSports, and professional teams.

rubrics_metrics.name: Yoga class
rubrics_metrics.description: Accessible stretching and relaxation classes useful for team bonding and wellbeing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do it like a pro: Hire a professional instructor, ensure mic/sound for large groups, choose a safe, accessible venue, and consider variations like hot yoga.

rubrics_metrics.name: Hackathon
rubrics_metrics.description: Time-limited events where programmers/designers build prototypes to address challenges, often fueled by pizza and caffeine.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do it like a pro: Define the challenge type and format (timeframe/rules) in advance and provide essentials like food.

rubrics_metrics.name: Immersive event
rubrics_metrics.description: Narrative-driven events with actors and movie-set settings that guide participants through a story for a highly memorable experience.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do it like a pro: Develop a compelling narrative, believable settings, and test the scenario or storyboard before the event day.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pitch contest
rubrics_metrics.description: Rapid-fire pitches from startups or speakers to panels/audience to win prizes, exposing new talent.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do it like a pro: Use an MC to manage speaker transitions, enforce time slots, and set clear judging criteria.

rubrics_metrics.name: Meet-up
rubrics_metrics.description: Informal gatherings of people with shared interests, held in physical or virtual spaces.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do it like a pro: Prepare a set list of discussion topics and choose a convenient, conversation-friendly location; include a fun Q&A if desired.

rubrics_metrics.name: Puzzle or escape room
rubrics_metrics.description: Group puzzle-solving events in a timed, closed environment (physical or online) that combine excitement and collaboration.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do it like a pro: Create an engaging storyline, choose puzzles carefully, and assign a knowledgeable game master to monitor and provide hints.

rubrics_metrics.name: Quiz
rubrics_metrics.description: Teams compete by answering questions posed by a quizmaster, often in rounds with multimedia elements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do it like a pro: Select topics suited to attendees, prepare questions in organized rounds, and include high-quality multimedia like music and visuals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Retreat
rubrics_metrics.description: Longer-form gatherings (often weekends) focused on meditation, relaxation, self-growth, or team-building.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do it like a pro: Create a safe space, set expectations in advance, and research suitable meditation/mindfulness/team-building activities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Roasts
rubrics_metrics.description: Humorous events honoring someone with affectionate mocking rather than sincere praise.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do it like a pro: Choose someone skilled at delivering comedic one-liners, keep it lighthearted, and prepare a few lines while allowing others to contribute.

rubrics_metrics.name: Open mic
rubrics_metrics.description: Low-stakes events where attendees perform poetry, music, or comedy, giving aspiring artists stage time.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do it like a pro: Pre-sign one or two performers to start the event and build momentum so others feel comfortable performing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Secret event
rubrics_metrics.description: Events where the agenda or nature is kept secret to pique curiosity and engagement during the lead-up.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do it like a pro: Plan ahead and send carefully worded teasers that hint without revealing the surprise.

rubrics_metrics.name: Workshops
rubrics_metrics.description: Hands-on sessions where attendees create something tangible (art, crafts), fostering creativity and teamwork.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do it like a pro: Survey attendees for in-house skills to cut costs, and if hiring an instructor, invest in quality materials or space.

rubrics_metrics.name: Roundtable
rubrics_metrics.description: Discussions where attendees address the same question and debate answers; useful for city planning and business innovation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do it like a pro: Appoint an impartial moderator to ensure every voice is heard and to manage contentious participants.

rubrics_metrics.name: Debate
rubrics_metrics.description: Structured face-offs between experts to compare beliefs or approaches; influential when done well.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do it like a pro: Give debaters time to prepare and provide guidelines for respectful audience engagement to maintain focus.

rubrics_metrics.name: Paint jam
rubrics_metrics.description: Timed painting events (competitive or casual) held online where participants create art in a limited period.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do it like a pro: Create a variety of prize categories to include less experienced participants (most creative, most beautiful, best material use).

rubrics_metrics.name: Scavenger hunt or treasure hunt
rubrics_metrics.description: Virtual or in-person hunts that encourage team coordination, creativity, and critical thinking.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do it like a pro: Add bonus points for creativity or coordination to reward standout team behaviors.

rubrics_metrics.name: Virtual reality event
rubrics_metrics.description: Immersive events using VR to augment in-person or deliver unique remote experiences; requires equipment.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do it like a pro: Ensure attendees have necessary gear; consider renting and providing equipment to those who lack it.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reunion
rubrics_metrics.description: Reunions of classmates, coworkers, or teammates to reconnect and create belonging.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do it like a pro: Give plenty of advance notice and emphasize that attendance is low-pressure (ok to join briefly or leave early).

rubrics_metrics.name: Virtual tour
rubrics_metrics.description: Live-guided tours led by an expert who navigates between venues on camera; can be recorded for later sharing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do it like a pro: Choose an experienced guide who can bring locations to life with vivid descriptions and stories; enhance with VR where possible.

rubrics_metrics.name: Webinar
rubrics_metrics.description: Online seminars for education or lead capture where attendees dial in by phone or web and follow slides; recordable.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do it like a pro: Consider multiple sessions for time zones, provide handouts or slides, and use video conferencing tools (Zoom) for interactivity.
